# Resume facts (generated by src/resume_facts.py from reports/tables)

Every number below is read from this run's output files. Rounding is the only change.

## Data
- Source: NYC TLC Yellow Taxi trip records, 12 monthly Parquet files (Jan-Dec 2024).
- Raw rows loaded: 41,169,720
- Rows after cleaning: 39,435,384 (4.21% dropped by 7 explicit rules, logged per rule)
- Taxi zones in the hourly grid: 263 (pickups recorded in 261)
- Hours in the grid: 8,784; zone-hour rows: 2,310,192
- Zones with >= 10 pickups/day used for inference: 143

## Forecasting (citywide hourly pickups, rolling origin, expanding window)
- Folds: 12; horizons 24h and 168h; baseline = seasonal naive lag 168
- 168h: calendar_sarima MASE 1.035 vs seasonal naive 1.130; MAE ratio 0.924 (7.6% lower MAE); better in 7 of 12 folds
- 24h: calendar_sarima MASE 0.880 vs seasonal naive 0.860; MAE ratio 1.029; better in 4 of 12 folds. Does NOT beat the baseline at 24h.
- First SARIMA specification (daily differencing + Fourier): MAE ratio vs baseline 1.64 at 168h, 2.03 at 24h (worse than baseline)
- MSTL seasonal strength: daily 0.98, weekly 0.92

## Hypothesis tests (weekday vs weekend daily pickups per zone)
- Zones tested: 143; test: Mann-Whitney U (chosen because 86% of zones reject normality)
- Significant at p<0.05 before correction: 116
- Significant after Benjamini-Hochberg (FDR 5%): 114 (62 busier on weekends, 52 quieter)
- Nulls after correction: 29

## Logit (zone-hour above its zone's 75th percentile; two-way clustered SEs)
- Rows: 1,256,112 zone-hours, 143 zones
- Odds ratio, 16-19h vs 10-15h: 1.34 (95% CI 1.12-1.59, p=0.001)
- Odds ratio, 00-05h vs 10-15h: 0.22 (95% CI 0.16-0.29, p=8.9e-24)
- Odds ratio, holiday: 0.59 (95% CI 0.43-0.81, p=0.0013)
- Odds ratio, weekend: 1.16 (95% CI 0.97-1.39, p=0.094) (CI includes 1)
- Max VIF: 1.50
- Oct-Dec holdout: AUC 0.668, Brier 0.172 (constant-rate Brier 0.183); mean predicted 0.180 vs observed 0.236: under-predicts out of time, not well calibrated

## Effect sizes behind the findings
- Citywide Tue-Thu 17-19h vs 10-15h pickups/hour: 1.32x (95% CI 1.28-1.36)
- Manhattan Sat/Sun 00-02h vs Mon-Thu 00-02h: 5.99x (95% CI 5.58-6.42)
- Top 10 zones' share of all pickups: 38.0%; zones covering 80% of pickups: 31

## Do not claim
- That a model beats the seasonal naive at the 24h horizon.
- Undersupply or unmet demand (no supply data; pickups are completed trips).
- Weather, events or multi-year effects (not in the data).
- The logit as a calibrated probability model.
